This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[species]] was distinguished by their insectoid heads, with large compound [[Eye|eyes]], twin green [[Antenna|antennae]] extending out from the center of their faces, small mandibles, and black and red skin covered in fine [[Hair|hairs]]. If members of this species were separated from their hives for too long, they would die.<ref name="The Curse" /> 

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:BrizzitFlees-2015StarWars12.png|thumb|left|200px|A member of this species fleeing from Grakkus' Palace Arena.]]
In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]''</ref> a member of this species could be found within [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]] on the day [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived to meet [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]].<ref name="ANH" /> That same year,<ref name="SW12 Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'' (2015) 12 to [[0 ABY]].</ref> a member of this species was in attendance at the the [[Grakkus Arena]] at the [[Palace of Grakkus the Hutt]] in [[Hutta Town]] on the [[moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa]], fleeing during the chaos when [[Luke Skywalker]]'s [[Rescue of Luke Skywalker|friends came to rescue him]].<ref name="SW12" /> Sometime between [[3 ABY]] or [[4 ABY]],<ref name="The Curse Date">The events of "The Curse" take place after the [[Escape from Cloud City]] and before the [[Rescue of Han Solo]], which are dated to [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]], respectively, by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''.</ref> another member of this species came into conflict with a group thieves after working for them for three years, stating they had completed their contract and attempting to leave to go be with their people, while their employers manipulatively claimed they still owned interest and would never be going home. This individual was then saved by [[Sabé]], who came across the scene while conducting business in an [[Unidentified cantina (Sergia)|unidentified cantina]] on the [[planet]] [[Sergia]].<ref name="The Curse" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Brizzit.png|thumb|right|200px|The Brizzit Costume created for ''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope''.]]
This species, referred to as the [[Brizzit]]s within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, were created for the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]], though they were nearly entirely edited out of the final film, only seen briefly in the backgrounds of certain shots.<ref name="ANH" />
